reviews.comment: This class is really easy but her lectures are so dull. She just reads off the slides. The quizzes were not awful but the final was insane. She did curve it like crazy though.

She lectures quickly, but thoroughly. Very organized overall - lecture slides are clearly outlined, HWs and biweekly quizzes are straightforward and directly correlated with lectures, semester-long project is doable, and exams are straightforward and similar to the HW assignments.
Great professor, easy class. Quizzes are straightforward. It is a little boring because its just reading off slides, but it is not hard.

Dr. Qiu is very knowledgeable, passionate, and has clear lecture slides. She's very responsive via email and after class. HW is graded for completion. The group project isn't difficult and the project + peer evals are 20% of your grade. The final is like her biweekly quizzes, slightly difficult. Overall, this course is very doable and rather easy.

Pretty boring class, lectures are just her reading off slides. Had me rather stressed about my grades because of the cursed True/False quizzes since one T/F wrong and you're already at a 90. Thankfully quizzes+test are only 50% of your grade and the rest are free points (project + completion grade HW). Final was pretty hard but graded leniently.

Okay professor, class is pretty dull and lecture heavy. Completion grade homework with biweekly quizzes, project, and a final that was decently difficult. You can tell she is here for research, not to teach. Stopped going to class because it was boring. Meh class in general

Bi-week quizzes weren't bad. Make sure you do well on them. She has a thick accent but material isn't that hard to understand. HW was just completion and effort. 2-projects but were easy if you did the work. Peer review for project was 15% of final exam grade. Overall super super cool class and pretty easy like meen 210
